general_information.Description: This course explores the central concepts of organisational procurement, global sourcing and interfaces of these to the other areas of an organisation. This course provides opportunities to examine issues such as organisational procurement process, global sourcing process, supplier selection process, supplier management and other strategic issues. *Teaching method: This is a blended-learning course, in which students will take a look at the videos & slides and reading on Coursera first at home, then rewatch & discuss key questions with classmates and teachers at classes. AI Tools will be used to support students in (1) generating ideas/structures for their speaking notes and slide structure of important topics of the course. (2) editing the slide set after students have already finished it.
general_information.StudentTasks: - Access the learning materials on Coursera for self-study purposes - Attend at least 80% of contact hours in order to be eligible for the final assessment - Actively participate in class activities - Fulfill tasks given by instructor after class - Use their own laptop in class only for learning purpose - Access FU FLM at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: demonstrate basic understanding of procurement of an enterprise
demonstrate understanding of stakeholder management in the given context of an enterprise
demonstrate the ability to select and evaluate supplier
practice the ability to develop a supplier evaluation system for an enterprise
discuss various types of contracts that can be used in procurement
demonstrate understanding of risk in procurement and the ability to mitigate it
discuss some ethical considerations in procurement
apply tools to evaluate a Supply Market from Macro, Industry, and Supplier Level
practice the ability to conduct negotiation in procurement
demonstrate proficiency in applying AI tools to develop solutions to professional issues
